title: La Kour — The Barrens (Warcraft, English)
description:
Kalimdor, between Durotar and Theramore. The Barrens, a sun-scorched savannah where caravans, kraals and the merchants of the Crossroads meet, live on a fragile peace between the Horde and the Alliance — and under the ashes, the embers of the Legion still smoulder.

Contracts, dungeons and reputations: take the road. D&D 5e (2024 rules), run by the AI GM.
